Linode vs Kloudbean: Unmanaged VPS or Managed Cloud?

Quick thread 🧵
Linode vs Kloudbean isn't strictly either/or.
Kloudbean can provision and manage a server on Linode's own infrastructure, so the real comparison is a raw Linode VPS you administer yourself versus the same Linode box with a managed layer on top.
Run it yourself and you own the patching, stack, SSL, backups, deploys, and monitoring.
Let Kloudbean manage it and those are handled, on Linode or six other clouds, from one dashboard.
